author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the DeFlock campaign again and have some good updates as more and more cities terminate these surveillance cameras and the company is forced to gaslight us into thinking these are good. People are waking up, fighting back and it's leading to some real wins. Thanks for watching!

title: WE'RE FINALLY GETTING WINS AGAINST FLOCK...
